title: Texas Ethics Advisory Opinion No. 7
text:
TEXAS ETHICS COMMISSION
ETHICS ADVISORY OPINION NO. 7
April 23, 1992
Whether a person filing a
report under title 15 of the Election Code may substitute a form for the form prescribed
by the Ethics Commission. (AOR-9)
The Texas Ethics Commission has
been asked to consider whether a general-purpose committee may substitute its own form for
a page of the form prescribed by the commission and designated "General-Purpose
Committee Sworn Report of Contributions and Expenditures."
The General-Purpose Committee
Sworn Report of Contributions and Expenditures is a reporting form that provides places
for a general-purpose political committee to disclose all the information required by
sections 254.031 and 254.151 of the Election Code. These sections require information
about the committee itself, about contributions the committee has accepted, and about
expenditures it has made.
Each report filed under title 15
of the Election Code must be on a form prescribed by the commission unless the report is a
computer printout. Elec. Code § 254.036(a). When a report is on a computer printout, the
printout must conform to the same format and paper size as the form prescribed by the
commission. Apart from permitting the use of a computer printout, the statute does not
permit a person filing a report to substitute a form in place of the prescribed form or a
page in place of a page of the form adopted by the commission. The commission recognizes,
however, that the spaces allocated for listing certain contributions and expenditures on
the prescribed forms may not be well suited to a particular person's needs. In such a case
the person may submit a proposed attachment for approval by commission staff. Any proposed
attachment must be of the same paper size as the prescribed form. The information must
appear on the attachment in substantially the same format as it would have appeared on the
prescribed form. If the commission staff approves an attachment, a person may use it by
noting on the appropriate page of the prescribed form that the requested information is on
an attachment.
The commission has been asked if
the form attached as Appendix A to this opinion may be substituted for Part G-06 of the
general-purpose committee report, which is attached as Appendix B. The form attached as
Appendix A may be used, with the changes described below, as an attachment to the
prescribed form if the person refers to the attachment on Part G-06 of the prescribed
form.
The form attached as Appendix A
does not have the same format as the full page of Part G-06, but it does have the same
format of the portion of Part G-06 that relates to the information that the requestor
seeks to disclose on the attachment. The headings on the attachment should reflect the
information to be reported on the attachment. Thus, in the case of the proposed attachment
in Appendix A, the column heading that now reads "Disbursements of cash not
previously reported" should repeat the full heading used on the commission form or
simply read "Disbursements of cash" if that is the only information to be
reported on the attachment. The heading that now reads "specific purpose" should
include the words "of expenditure."
SUMMARY
A person filing a report under
title 15 of the Election Code may not substitute a form in place of the prescribed form or
a page in place of a page of the form adopted by the commission unless the commission has
approved the use of the substitute form. For an attachment to be approved, the attachment
must be of the same paper size as the prescribed form. The information must appear on the
attachment in substantially the same format as it would have appeared on the prescribed
form.
